name: American Electric Company, LLC
old_description: With over seven decades of unparalleled experience, American Electric stands as Hawaii's gold standard in electrical services. Our reputation, built on trust and excellence since 1946, illuminates our commitment to powering the Aloha spirit.
about:
American Electric Company, LLC has been headquartered in Mililani, Hawaii since its founding in 1946. The company began as an electrical contractor serving the islands and has grown into a multi-service provider with over seven decades of experience.

The firm provides electrical construction, service, controls, telecom, and alternative energy solutions. Its construction division offers design/build services using BIM modeling, TotalStation, Revit, and prefabrication, as well as high-voltage system design, installation, and testing for power plants, manufacturing facilities, and data centers. As a TEGG® Service Contractor, it delivers guaranteed service programs, ultrasonic testing, and de-energized maintenance. The service team handles emergency repairs, installations, modifications, and diagnostic power quality work.

Customers span residential homeowners, commercial property managers, industrial contractors, and utility-scale operators. The company has served alternative energy projects, power generation plants, manufacturing facilities, and data centers across Hawaii.

American Electric emphasizes a customer-first approach with clear communication, timely completion, and transparent pricing. Its differentiation rests on the TEGG guaranteed service programs, in-house design/build capabilities with advanced modeling tools, and a workforce of licensed electricians who undergo regular training.

about:
American Mobility Products, Inc., operating as AMP Kentucky, is headquartered in Campbellsville, Kentucky, with additional offices in Lexington and Louisville. The company provides medical equipment solutions across the Commonwealth, focusing on augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) speech devices, sleep apnea and respiratory therapy equipment, and power mobility chairs.

AMP Kentucky supplies a range of durable medical equipment through dedicated sleep, speech, and respiratory teams. These in-house specialists handle product selection, fitting, and ongoing clinical support for patients. The three Kentucky locations serve as local points of contact for equipment delivery, training, and therapy consultation.

The company serves individuals with speech, sleep, and mobility impairments, as well as healthcare providers and caregivers seeking reliable medical equipment. Its respiratory therapists and speech-language pathology staff work directly with patients and prescribing clinicians to ensure compliance and adherence to prescribed therapy programs.

AMP Kentucky states its goal is to offer high-quality, cost-effective medical equipment solutions that enable customers to achieve the highest possible quality of life, summarized in the tagline “Transforming Care. Elevating Lives.”

name: American Semiconductor, Inc.
old_description: American Semiconductor’s advanced packaging technology and services provide thin capabilities. ASI’s offerings include Semiconductor-on-Polymer™ chip scale packaging, chip-on-flex assembly and a wide variety of engineering and design services. See List of Services & Products below.
about:
American Semiconductor, Inc. (ASI) operates from Boise, Idaho, where it develops advanced packaging technologies for thin and flexible electronic systems. The company focuses on semiconductor-on-polymer chip-scale packaging and chip-on-flex assembly, supported by a suite of engineering and design services.

ASI's service portfolio spans the full development cycle: design and integration, prototype fabrication, wafer-level test, system and reliability testing, and final assembly of packaged ICs and test chips. Its Multi-Project Substrate (MPS) program enables shared-run prototyping on advanced flexible substrates, while the Nobleflex™ and Ultraflex™ material lines deliver feature resolution down to 1 µm on polymer and flexible printed circuit boards. The company also supplies thin, flexible development kits for Bluetooth, NFC, and data-acquisition applications.

Customers include developers of flexible hybrid electronics, wearable sensors, and internet-of-things devices who require rapid prototyping and low-volume production of ultra-thin packages. The firm's test and assembly services are used to validate chip-on-flex designs and to qualify packaged devices for reliability in demanding form factors.

name: American Steel Fabrication
old_description: Locally owned and operated, American Steel Fabrication is a hands-on subcontractor big enough to handle large projects across the Midwest and small enough to take care of each customer and the inevitable details that follow every project. Having been in business for over 27 years, The ASFI Community is stronger than ever. We pride ourselves on having the best clients in the business, providing a quality product at competitive prices in a fast, friendly and flexible way. President Tim Thomas understands the needs of both clients and contractors and delivers quality workmanship every time. A premier member of the American Subcontractors Association, Midwest Council, American Steel Fabrication has a stellar reputation for unmatched experience and performance.
about:
American Steel Fabrication was founded in 1994 in Pevely, Missouri, by Tim Thomas and a group of his customers. The locally owned and operated company began as a hands-on subcontractor focused on steel fabrication and has grown into a respected steel manufacturer serving the Midwest. President Tim Thomas, who started in the steel construction industry at age 15, leads the business with a background in business and finance.

The company runs a complete fabrication facility producing structural steel — including beams, angles, channels, pipe, tube, plates, bars, sheets, embeds, and pipe bollards — in carbon, stainless, and aluminum. It also fabricates reinforcing steel in all sizes and grades, with epoxy coating, wire mesh, tie wire, mechanical couplers, and concrete accessories. A full inventory is stocked for same-day pickup and next-day delivery, and the firm provides ironworker erection and installation services.

American Steel Fabrication works primarily with general contractors and project owners on commercial, industrial, and infrastructure construction across the Midwest. A notable project includes supplying reinforcing steel for the Ameren Bagnell Dam stabilization, a 2,453-foot gravity dam requiring extensive post-tension anchor installation.

The company says it differentiates itself through fast, flexible, and friendly service, competitive pricing, and a commitment to lifelong customer relationships built on open communication and community involvement.

name: Amtech Systems, Llc
old_description: Founded in 1998, Entrepix, Inc. has become the most recognized independent provider of chemical mechanical polishing (CMP)technology. An early pioneer of the refurbished equipment market, Entrepix subsequently launched the first CMP outsourcing service, through which it developed and now operates the world’s largest CMP technology portfolio. Today Entrepix is the OEM for new OnTrak cleaners and has heavily invested in engineering and fabrication resources to design, develop, and manufacture upgrades, obsolescence solutions, sub-assemblies, and complete electro-mechanical systems for CMP-style polishing and cleaning as well as aerospace defense contracting. Entrepix proudly serves a long and growing lis tof customers that includes many of the world’s most prominent IC fabricators,OEMs, materials suppliers, and defense contractors.
about:
Amtech Systems, Inc. (ASYS) is headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Founded in 1981, the company operates as a global supplier of semiconductor equipment and materials through four wholly-owned subsidiaries: BTU International, Entrepix Inc., PR Hoffman, and Intersurface Dynamics.

The company designs, manufactures, and sells capital equipment and consumables for semiconductor fabrication, advanced packaging, and electronics assembly. Its process portfolio spans chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), lapping, polishing, cleaning, etching, belt and diffusion furnaces, and solder reflow ovens, including the TrueFlat line for ultra-thin substrates. Amtech maintains eight locations across five countries.

Customers include integrated circuit fabricators, OEMs, materials suppliers, defense contractors, and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers. The equipment serves end markets such as mobile, computing, industrial, automotive, telecommunications, medical, and power semiconductors, with high-volume reflow systems deployed for AI semiconductor device packaging.

Amtech states its differentiator is the quality of its products and customer service, positioning itself as a supplier of high-quality solutions. Its growth strategy focuses on the silicon carbide and power semiconductor sectors, leveraging subsidiaries like Entrepix for CMP services and BTU for thermal processing equipment.

Several items are sold under the Jamy's Three Dragon label. A notable capability is the in-house production of egg roll wrappers. Amy Food serves both foodservice and retail channels. Its Jamy's Three Dragon products are distributed to restaurants, distributors and grocery retailers, though specific customer names are not provided.

The company states that its differentiation comes from blending time-honored recipes with meticulous care to deliver meals that taste like home, a philosophy that has guided its 30-year journey.
